name: headshot-photo-check
description: Check an existing professional profile or job-application photo for dimensions, aspect ratio, format and file size. When pixel analysis is available, measure whole-image exposure, contrast, color balance, border-background structure and coarse sharpness. Results explain coverage, prioritize technical improvements and suggest crops for LinkedIn, XING and applications.

interface.longDescription: Check an existing professional profile or job-application photo for dimensions, aspect ratio, format and file size. When pixel analysis is available, measure whole-image exposure, contrast, color balance, border-background structure and coarse sharpness. Results explain coverage, prioritize technical improvements and suggest crops for LinkedIn, XING and applications. Supply one public HTTPS image URL or base64 JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 8,000,000 decoded bytes. URL checks contact user-selected image hosts. Cloudflare Images may internally resize inputs for analysis; no edited photo is returned. Without that binding, only tiny JPEG/PNG inputs receive pixel checks; other inputs receive explicit header-only results. Scores cover checked criteria only. Face framing requires manual review. The requirements tool returns static recommendations rather than official platform upload limits. Images are processed in memory and are not stored by the application. Cloudflare and Netlify process infrastructure traffic; operational metadata is logged. No face recognition, biometric identification or personal-attribute judgments. This service only analyzes existing images: it does not generate images, video or audio.

positive.prompt: Give me the technical photo requirements for LinkedIn.
positive.expected_behavior: Return target linkedin, maximum 8,000,000 bytes, static preparation checklist and only the requested destination crop: 1:1.

positive.prompt: Give me the technical photo requirements for XING.
positive.expected_behavior: Return target xing, maximum 8,000,000 bytes, static preparation checklist and only the requested destination crop: 1:1.

positive.prompt: Give me the technical photo requirements for a job application.
positive.expected_behavior: Return target application, maximum 8,000,000 bytes, static preparation checklist and only the requested destination crop: 3:4, 2:3 or 4:5; square also usable.
